suggestions.what: Full-screen stinger and sound for extreme orders (nuke, war, coup) with a visible consequence
Make the end card a postable picture with a hero image, the biggest moment and chaos stats (strikes, wars, lives lost), not a text box
Show a toast when Share result or Copy text works
Let me skip the newspaper and go straight to the next desk, keep the clicks safe

delight: Title globe with pinned fires and TODAY badge looked great on stream
YOUR PICK stamp and IT WORKED +6 stinger cards
Clear reasons on blocked orders (needs 2 capital, only in wartime)
Reveal sequence with grade stamp, count-up score, seals, truth vs real world table
Ladder against random and do-nothing staff

fun.reason: Good flow and some great cards, but my wild moves fizzled and I won the war in month 3 by clicking aggressive options.

clarity.reason: Costs and refusals were readable, names were not.

visual.reason: Globe, scene art and reveal look good on camera; desk is a bit busy.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Months, stingers, grade, seals and replay feel like a game.

agency.reason: Every refusal told me why, but allowed extreme moves had little effect.

realism.reason: A nuke-site strike on China with no war felt fake; the truth table was cool.

replay.reason: Replay same opening and New world are right there, I would try Iran or nukes next time.

recommend.reason: Chat would enjoy the end reveal but I need bigger chaos payoffs and a postable card.

verbatim: The reveal is the best part, I would clip that. But I nuked a Chinese site and they just tweeted at me. Give me explosions.
